2026-FilterAttention.mechanism_en: Veins have a tubular shape that can guide segmentation. A multiscale Frangi filter detects that structure and supplies weights for the encoder features.

2026-Gated-DeltaNet-2.mechanism_zh: 擦掉多少旧记忆，和写入多少新信息，可以各自决定。Gated DeltaNet-2 在已有衰减之外，为擦除和写入分别设置逐通道门。
2026-Gated-DeltaNet-2.mechanism_en: Gated DeltaNet-2 separates how much memory to erase from how much to write. Each operation gets its own channel-wise gate alongside the state's adaptive decay.
2026-Gated-DeltaNet-2.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed. Matrix multiplication independently verified the recurrence in a case that triggered the safeguard. The maximum absolute difference was 1.19e-07.

2026-HA.mechanism_zh: 田块内部常连成一片，边界却只占很窄的一条。HA 先给边缘特征的通道加权，再用空间权重突出可能的地块分界。
2026-HA.mechanism_en: Farmland boundaries can occupy only a few pixels. Hybrid attention reweights the channels of the edge features and uses a spatial map to emphasize likely parcel borders.

2026-HFA.mechanism_zh: 金属在一张投影上遮住的细节，换个角度可能看得到。HFA 根据内容给同一视角和跨视角的特征分权，再把它们合成补全线索。
2026-HFA.mechanism_en: One CT projection may hide detail that another angle can supply. HFA adaptively weights and fuses within-view and across-view features for metal artifact correction.

2026-InfSA.mechanism_zh: 一层注意力只汇总一步可达的信息。InfSA 把注意力看成 token 间的扩散，将各步的传播结果按步数折扣后累加。
2026-InfSA.mechanism_en: InfSA treats attention as a step of diffusion on a graph of tokens. It sums the results of repeated steps, discounting longer paths to account for indirect relationships.

2026-LCGA.mechanism_zh: 遥感图像放大后，道路和河岸容易断成几截。LCGA 用深度卷积估计局部弯曲线索，再把它带进窗口注意力，给连贯的边缘多分权重。
2026-LCGA.mechanism_en: Roads and riverbanks can break up when a satellite image is enlarged. LCGA estimates local curvature with depthwise filters and uses it to guide attention within each window.

2026-Log-Linear-Attention.mechanism_zh: 固定大小的状态会把越来越长的历史挤进同一块记忆。Log-Linear Attention 保留多组递推状态，随着序列变长，状态数按对数增加。
2026-Log-Linear-Attention.mechanism_en: A single fixed-size state must compress more history as the sequence grows. Log-Linear Attention keeps a set of recurrent states whose count grows logarithmically with the context.

2026-MHLA.mechanism_zh: 线性注意力让所有查询共用一个上下文，输出容易变得相似。MHLA 沿 token 轴分头，每个头在自己的 token 组内单独做线性注意力。
2026-MHLA.mechanism_en: Sharing one global summary can make linear attention outputs too similar. MHLA splits the tokens into heads and computes a separate linear-attention summary within each group.

2026-MSEA.mechanism_zh: 红外小目标的轮廓又细又淡，层层下采样会把它抹掉。MSEA 把边缘特征对齐到各尺度，再用有边缘监督的注意力突出轮廓。
2026-MSEA.mechanism_en: Faint infrared targets can lose their edges as features are downsampled. MSEA brings edge cues to several resolutions and uses edge supervision to guide the attention at those scales.

2026-MetaCompress.mechanism_zh: 第一轮问答之后，下一问可能落到图像的另一角。MetaCompress 学习怎样压缩视觉 token，压缩时不读当前问题，以便多轮共用。
2026-MetaCompress.mechanism_en: A follow-up question can refer to a different corner of the image. MetaCompress learns a question-independent mapping that compresses visual tokens for reuse across turns.

2026-PAB.mechanism_zh: 远程状态扫描能看见全图，却容易掠过像素周围的细节。PAB 给各通道组用不同尺度的近邻注意力，再按像素选择怎样融合。
2026-PAB.mechanism_en: PAB brings back local detail that a long image scan can miss. It applies neighborhood attention at several scales and adapts the mixture to each pixel.

2026-PAT-sp.mechanism_zh: 整张特征图的通道没必要都算空间门。PAT-sp 把通道拆开，一路做空间注意力，另一路用点卷积混合通道，再拼回两路。
2026-PAT-sp.mechanism_en: PAT-sp uses spatial attention on part of the channels and pointwise convolution on another part. The two paths meet again at the output.

2026-PartialAttention.mechanism_zh: 检测骨干里，让所有通道都做自注意力会拉高开销。Partial ViT 只让一部分通道参与注意力，其余通道绕过这一计算。
2026-PartialAttention.mechanism_en: Partial ViT sends only a subset of channels through self-attention. The remaining channels bypass that operation, reducing the cost of the detection backbone.

2026-RELA.mechanism_zh: 线性注意力的低秩权重可能把不同位置混得太像。RELA 加入深度卷积补上局部变化，增加读出特征的秩。
2026-RELA.mechanism_en: RELA adds depthwise convolution to linear attention. The extra local mixing raises the rank of the output features, helping the network retain distinct details across the image.

2026-SA-CA.mechanism_zh: 摩尔纹对各颜色通道的影响不一样，也会随位置变化。SA-CA 先用卷积收集空间信息，再按这些信息在通道之间分配注意力。
2026-SA-CA.mechanism_en: Moiré affects color channels differently from one region to another. SA-CA first gathers spatial cues with convolutions, then uses them to guide interactions across channels.

2026-SAMC.mechanism_zh: 超声切面的区别有时只在几条细小结构上。SAMC 用不同尺度的卷积处理特征，再依次算通道门和空间门，留下有辨识度的细节。
2026-SAMC.mechanism_en: SAMC uses parallel convolutions at several scales to capture small anatomical differences. Channel attention and then spatial attention refine those features before ultrasound plane recognition.

2026-SCFM.mechanism_zh: 把超高清图像汇成少量簇中心，容易丢掉纹理。SCFM 在聚类分支旁给空间位置和通道分别加权，补回像素级细节。
2026-SCFM.mechanism_en: Cluster summaries can lose fine texture in very large images. SCFM runs spatial and channel attention alongside the cluster pathway to preserve local details.

2026-SFC.mechanism_zh: 遥感图里目标尺寸差得很大，光靠全图线索难以描出边缘。SFC 用两路门控混合局部细节和较大范围的上下文，校准目标边界。
2026-SFC.mechanism_en: SFC refines the boundaries of salient objects in aerial images. Two gates blend local detail with broader context so the model can handle objects at different scales.

2026-SSC.mechanism_zh: 高光谱融合要补空间细节，又要留住波段间的区别。SSC 分开计算空间和光谱相关性，再汇总两路特征，省去联合打分。
2026-SSC.mechanism_en: Fusing spectral and spatial imagery calls for both fine geometry and distinct spectral bands. SSC factors the aggregation into separate spatial and spectral correlations to avoid a joint attention matrix.

2026-Softpick.mechanism_zh: softmax 强制每行用完全部权重，有些位置会无故吸走注意力。Softpick 把低于零点的贡献截掉，保留分母归一化，但允许权重总和小于一。
2026-Softpick.mechanism_en: Softpick can give some tokens exactly zero weight. It rectifies attention weights and uses a denominator that lets the row sum fall short of one, reducing pressure to attend somewhere.
2026-Softpick.check_en: The comparison used the same random input for four Q/KV heads and for four Q heads with two KV heads. The maximum absolute differences in the outputs and weights were both 0.

2026-VHCA.mechanism_zh: 屏下相机的复原既要修局部模糊，也要让长线条连贯。VHCA 分开沿横向和纵向做交叉注意力，用两条轴传递远处的图像线索。
2026-VHCA.mechanism_en: VHCA carries restoration cues along horizontal and vertical directions with separate cross-attention passes. Long image structures can share information without a dense two-dimensional attention map.

2026-ViSOR.mechanism_zh: 把视觉 token 删掉，细小文字也可能跟着消失。ViSOR 保留全部视觉 token，让文本用交叉注意力按需读取，只在选中的层做视觉自注意力。
2026-ViSOR.mechanism_en: ViSOR keeps all high-resolution visual tokens available for cross-attention from text. A small set of selected self-attention layers refines those visual features when the task needs more detail.

na-BAM.mechanism_zh: 下采样前，仍有机会把有用的细节留住。BAM 把通道与空间分数相加，再做 sigmoid。所得门值乘回输入，再加上原特征。
na-BAM.mechanism_en: BAM places a gate where the feature resolution changes. It adds channel and spatial scores and applies a sigmoid, then adds a gated copy of the features back to the input.

na-GENet.mechanism_zh: 卷积只看局部，位置附近有什么并不总能说明它属于哪里。Gather-Excite 先从更大范围汇总每个通道，再把汇总结果变成局部权重。
na-GENet.mechanism_en: Gather-Excite gives local convolutional features access to a wider view. Its gather step pools channel responses over a large area, and its excite step feeds that context back as local weights.

na-SBA.mechanism_zh: 深层特征指出物体大致在哪儿，浅层特征保留了边缘。SBA 让两种特征互相提供门值，把边界线索和物体内部的信息合起来。
na-SBA.mechanism_en: SBA brings shallow boundary details together with deeper cues about the object as a whole. The two feature levels gate one another before their information is fused.
